items_flat.title_en: OpenAI joins PORTS-Pike project for ~8 GW AI capacity in Ohio
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 加入 PORTS-Pike 專案，鎖定俄亥俄約 8 GW AI 算力
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced it has secured approximately 8 gigawatts-IT at the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Pike County, Ohio, working with SB Energy, NVIDIA and the U.S. Department of Energy. SB Energy will build, own and operate the site under a 20-year lease; NVIDIA will invest $1.5 billion in SB Energy and provide credit support for the initial 4.25 IT-GW while serving as exclusive AI compute provider. The project targets 35,000 construction jobs through 2032, 2,500 long-term roles, $80 million combined community investment, and up to $84 million in Codex credits for Ohio students.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布已取得俄亥俄州 Pike 縣 PORTS-Pike 科技園區約 8 吉瓦 IT 算力，與 SB Energy、NVIDIA 及美國能源部合作。SB Energy 將以 20 年租約興建、擁有並營運該園區；NVIDIA 將投資 SB Energy 15 億美元並為初期 4.25 IT-GW 提供信用支持，同時作為唯一 AI 算力供應商。專案預計創造 3.5 萬個建設工作與 2,500 個長期職缺、合計 8,000 萬美元社區投資，以及高達 8,400 萬美元 Codex 學分給俄亥俄學生。
items_flat.analysis_en: This ranks among 2026’s largest single AI infrastructure commitments and shows OpenAI locking multi-year power and land at industrial scale while explicitly tying the deal to local jobs, water stewardship and student access. Key uncertainty remains the pace of grid and generation build-out required beyond the first 800 MW expected in 2028.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此為 2026 年規模最大的單一 AI 基礎建設承諾之一，顯示 OpenAI 以工業級規模鎖定多年電力與土地，並明確與在地就業、節水及學生近用連結。關鍵不確定性在於 2028 年首批 800 MW 之後所需電網與發電建設進度。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI has entered into an agreement to secure approximately 8 gigawatts-IT at the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Pike County, Ohio, working with SB Energy, NVIDIA, and the U.S. Department of Energy.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI 已簽訂協議，取得俄亥俄州 Pike 縣 PORTS-Pike 科技園區約 8 吉瓦 IT 算力，與 SB Energy、NVIDIA 及美國能源部合作。

items_flat.title_en: Greg Brockman on “The Defender’s Window” after AI-enabled cyber incidents
items_flat.title_zh: Greg Brockman 發表《Defender’s Window》，談 AI 驅動網路攻擊後的防禦窗口
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI President Greg Brockman published “The Defender’s Window,” arguing that agentic AI is rapidly automating cyber attacks and that organizations have only a narrow period to uplevel defenses before the advantage shifts further to attackers. He details OpenAI’s internal four-pillar response (secure coding with Codex, continuous infrastructure defense, attack-path enumeration, and fundamentals at scale) and offers concrete steps other organizations can take immediately, including trusted-access cyber models.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 總裁 Greg Brockman 發表《The Defender’s Window》，指出代理式 AI 正快速自動化網路攻擊，組織僅有狹窄窗口可升級防禦，否則優勢將進一步轉向攻擊方。他詳述 OpenAI 內部四大支柱因應（Codex 安全編碼、持續基礎建設防禦、攻擊路徑盤點、規模化基本功），並提出其他組織可立即採取的具體步驟，包括可信存取網路模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: The piece frames cybersecurity as a race between dual-use AI capabilities rather than a pure product announcement. It reinforces OpenAI’s trusted-access approach for cyber models while publicly acknowledging underestimation of real-world agentic risk after the Hugging Face incident.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此文將資安定位為雙用 AI 能力的競賽，而非單純產品公告。它強化 OpenAI 對網路模型採可信存取策略，同時公開承認 Hugging Face 事件後對真實代理風險的低估。
items_flat.quote: defenders can see the future, and have a narrow window to uplevel their cybersecurity practices now. key is to uplevel fundamentals and apply the best AI tools.
items_flat.quote_zh: 防禦方可預見未來，現在僅有狹窄窗口可升級網路安全實務。關鍵是升級基本功並運用最佳 AI 工具。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI awards grants to 14 independent projects on AI economic opportunity and resilience
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 補助 14 個獨立專案，探討 AI 經濟機會與社會韌性
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced grants to 14 independent projects exploring how AI can broaden economic opportunity and strengthen societal resilience, covering jobs, benefits, safety, science and democratic accountability. The total commitment is $1 million in funding plus up to $1 million in API credits; projects span the US, EU, Brazil, Singapore and South Korea and will run for six months with results expected in 2027.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布補助 14 個獨立專案，探討 AI 如何擴大經濟機會並強化社會韌性，涵蓋就業、福利、安全、科學與民主問責。總承諾為 100 萬美元資金加上最高 100 萬美元 API 學分；專案橫跨美國、歐盟、巴西、新加坡與韓國，為期六個月，預計 2027 年提出成果。
items_flat.analysis_en: This follows through on OpenAI’s earlier “Industrial Policy for the Intelligence Age” paper and shifts the company from pure advocacy toward funding external policy experimentation. The modest dollar amount relative to infrastructure deals underscores that the signal is more about ecosystem influence than large-scale redistribution.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉延續 OpenAI 稍早《Industrial Policy for the Intelligence Age》白皮書，從純倡議轉向資助外部政策實驗。相對於基礎建設交易，金額不大，顯示訊號更在於生態系影響力而非大規模再分配。
items_flat.quote: We’re providing grants to 14 independent projects exploring how AI can broaden economic opportunity and strengthen society’s resilience—from jobs and benefits to safety, science, and democratic accountability.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正提供補助給 14 個獨立專案，探討 AI 如何擴大經濟機會並強化社會韌性——從就業與福利到安全、科學與民主問責。

brief_en: OpenAI dominated the window with three major moves: locking ~8 GW of NVIDIA-powered capacity at Ohio’s PORTS-Pike campus, Greg Brockman’s “Defender’s Window” cyber strategy post, and $1M+ grants to 14 independent economic-opportunity projects. No comparable flagship model or product launches from Anthropic, Google, Meta, xAI or others in the last 12 hours.
brief_zh: OpenAI 主導今日動態：鎖定俄亥俄 PORTS-Pike 約 8 GW NVIDIA 算力、Greg Brockman《Defender’s Window》資安策略文，以及 14 個經濟機會專案共逾 100 萬美元補助。Anthropic、Google、Meta、xAI 等過去 12 小時無對等旗艦模型或產品發布。
